follow-up time: Weekly during neonatal intensive care unit stay
finding: Preterm infants with suboptimal head circumference growth exhibited a depletion of Bacteroidota and Lachnospiraceae in their gut microbiome, suggesting a potential link between early gut colonization patterns and neurodevelopment.
mod_finding: Delivery mode, a factor influencing gut microbiome dispersal, was identified as a primary driver of optimal infant microbiome succession.
